import ctypes
import os

# Define the path to the GSL libraries
libgslcblas_path = "/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so"
libgsl_path = "/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so"

# Load the required libraries
if not os.path.exists(libgslcblas_path) or not os.path.exists(libgsl_path):
    raise FileNotFoundError("Required GSL libraries not found.")

ctypes.CDLL(libgslcblas_path, mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL(libgsl_path)

# Define the function prototype
gsl.gsl_sf_atanint_e.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)]
gsl.gsl_sf_atanint_e.restype = ctypes.c_int

# Define a function to call gsl_sf_atanint_e
def gsl_sf_atanint(x):
    result = ctypes.c_double()
    status = gsl.gsl_sf_atanint_e(ctypes.c_double(x), ctypes.byref(result))
    if status != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"GSL function gsl_sf_atanint_e failed with status {status}")
    return result.value

    # Test cases

    result2 = gsl_sf_atanint(1.0)

    result3 = gsl_sf_atanint(-1.0)
    assert abs(result3 - -0.915965594177219) < 1e-10, f"Test case failed: gsl_sf_atanint(-1.0) = {result3}"
